lines.english: Can I see the room?
lines.speaker: GUEST

lines.amharic: በእርግጥ! ይህ ክፍል መታጠቢያ ቤት እና ቲቪ አለው።
lines.english: Of course! This room has a bathroom and a TV.
lines.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
lines.transliteration: ba-irigit! yih kifil matatabiya bet inna tivi allaw.

lines.english: It's nice. I want this room.
lines.speaker: GUEST

lines.english: Show me your passport. Here is your key.
lines.speaker: RECEPTIONIST

lines.amharic: አመሰግናለሁ። ሙቅ ውሃ ቀኑን ሙሉ አለ?
lines.english: Thank you. Is there hot water all day?
lines.speaker: GUEST
lines.transliteration: ameseginalehu. muk wiha kanun mulu alla?

lines.amharic: አዎ፣ ሃያ አራት ሰዓት። መልካም ቆይታ!
lines.english: Yes, twenty-four hours. Enjoy your stay!
lines.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
lines.transliteration: awo, haya arat saat. melkam koyita!

lines.amharic: እንኳን ደህና መጡ! ለስንት ሰው ቦታ?
lines.english: Welcome! A table for how many?
lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.transliteration: inkuan dahna mattu! la-sint saw bota?

lines.english: For two people. Do you have a menu in English?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: ይቅርታ፣ በእንግሊዝኛ የለንም። ዛሬ ምን አለን ልበልዎ።
lines.english: Sorry, not in English. Let me tell you what we have today.
lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.transliteration: yikirta, ba-ingilizinya yallanim. zare min allan libalwo.

lines.english: OK. Do you have doro wat?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: አዎ! ዶሮ ወጥ፣ ጥብስ፣ ሽሮ፣ እና በያይነቱ አለ።
lines.english: Yes! We have doro wat, tibs, shiro, and the mixed platter.
lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.transliteration: awo! doro wat, tibs, shiro, inna bayayinatu alla.

lines.amharic: በያይነቱ እፈልጋለሁ። ስጋ አልበላም — የጾም ምግብ አለ?
lines.english: I want the mixed platter. I don't eat meat — do you have fasting food?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.transliteration: bayayinatu ifaligalahu. siga alballam — ya-tsom migib alla?

lines.amharic: አዎ! የጾም በያይነቱ ጥሩ ነው። ሽሮ፣ ምስር ወጥ፣ አትክልት።
lines.english: Yes! The fasting platter is great. Shiro, lentil stew, vegetables.
lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.transliteration: awo! ya-tsom bayayinatu tiru naw. shiro, misir wat, atikilt.

lines.amharic: ጥሩ! እሱን ይምጣ። ለመጠጥ ሁለት አምቦ ውሃ።
lines.english: Great! Bring that. For drinks, two Ambo waters.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.transliteration: tiru! issun yimta. la-matat hulat Ambo wiha.

lines.english: Are you satisfied?
lines.speaker: WAITER

lines.english: Yes, very delicious! The bill, please.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Hello. I need medicine.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Hello. What's the problem?
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST

lines.english: I have a cold. I have a cough.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Do you have a fever?
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST

lines.amharic: አዎ፣ ትንሽ ትኩሳት አለ። ራሴንም ያመኛል።
lines.english: Yes, a slight fever. My head also hurts.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.transliteration: awo, tinish tikusat alla. rasenim yamanynal.

lines.amharic: እሺ። የሳል መድሐኒት እና አስፕሪን እሰጥሃለሁ።
lines.english: OK. I'll give you cough medicine and aspirin.
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST
lines.transliteration: ishi. ya-sal madhanit inna asprin isatihalahu.

lines.english: How many times a day?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: ሦስት ጊዜ በቀን ከምግብ በኋላ። ብዙ ውሃ ጠጡ።
lines.english: Three times a day after meals. Drink lots of water.
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST
lines.transliteration: sost gize ba-kan ka-migib bahuwala. bizu wiha tat'u.

lines.english: How much is it?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: መቶ ሃምሳ ብር ነው። ብዙ እረፍ። ደህና ይሁኑ።
lines.english: It's 150 birr. Rest a lot. Get well.
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST
lines.transliteration: mato hamsa birr naw. bizu iraf. dahna yihunu.

lines.english: Hello. I want to change money.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Hello. What kind of currency?
lines.speaker: TELLER

lines.english: I have dollars. What's the exchange rate?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: ዛሬ አንድ ዶላር ሃምሳ ስድስት ብር ነው።
lines.english: Today one dollar is fifty-six birr.
lines.speaker: TELLER
lines.transliteration: zare and dolar hamsa sidist birr naw.

lines.english: OK. I'd like to change two hundred dollars.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: A passport is needed. Show me your passport.
lines.speaker: TELLER

lines.english: Here's my passport. Will you give me a receipt?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: አዎ፣ ደረሰኝ እሰጥዎታለሁ። ይጠብቁ — ገንዘብዎ እነሆ።
lines.english: Yes, I'll give you a receipt. Please wait — here is your money.
lines.speaker: TELLER
lines.transliteration: awo, darasany isatiwotalahu. yitabiku — ganzabwo inaho.

lines.english: Thank you.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Keep the receipt safe. Goodbye.
lines.speaker: TELLER

lines.amharic: ዛሬ ማታ የት እንሂድ? መዝናኛ እፈልጋለሁ!
lines.english: Where shall we go tonight? I want entertainment!
lines.speaker: PERSON A
lines.transliteration: zare mata yat inhid? maznanya ifaligalahu!

lines.amharic: ጥሩ አዝማሪ ቤት አውቃለሁ። የባህል ጨዋታ አለ።
lines.english: I know a good azmari bet. There's traditional entertainment.
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: tiru azmari bet awikalahu. ya-bahil chawata alla.

lines.english: What is an azmari bet?
lines.speaker: PERSON A

lines.amharic: ባህላዊ ሙዚቃ ቤት ነው። ማሲንቆ እና ክራር ይጫወታሉ።
lines.english: It's a traditional music house. They play masinko and krar.
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: bahilawi muzika bet naw. masinko inna kirar yichawatalu.

lines.english: Great! What's the entry fee?
lines.speaker: PERSON A

lines.amharic: መግቢያ ነጻ ነው። መጠጥ ብቻ ታዛዝ።
lines.english: Entry is free. You just order drinks.
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: magbiya natsa naw. matat bicha tazaz.

lines.amharic: ይህ ዳንስ ከየት ነው? በጣም ጎበዝ ዳንሰኛ!
lines.english: Where is this dance from? What a talented dancer!
lines.speaker: PERSON A
lines.transliteration: yih dans kayat naw? batam gobaz dansanya!

lines.amharic: ይህ እስክስታ ነው — የአማራ ባህል ነው። በትከሻ ይደንሳሉ።
lines.english: This is eskista — it's Amhara culture. They dance with their shoulders.
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: yih iskista naw — ya-Amara bahil naw. ba-tikasha yidinsalu.

lines.english: Let me try too! Is it hard?
lines.speaker: PERSON A

lines.amharic: ቀላል ነው! ና! በጣም ቆንጆ ጨዋታ ነው ዛሬ!
lines.english: It's easy! Come on! It's such a great show tonight!
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: kalal naw! na! batam konjo chawata naw zare!

lines.english: Excuse me! Help me! I've lost my bag.
lines.speaker: TOURIST

lines.english: Calm down. What happened? Where did you lose it?
lines.speaker: OFFICER

lines.amharic: ታክሲ ውስጥ ረሳሁት ይመስለኛል። ፓስፖርቴ ውስጡ ነው።
lines.english: I think I left it in a taxi. My passport is inside.
lines.speaker: TOURIST
lines.transliteration: taksi wist rasahut yimeslanynal. pasporte wistu naw.

lines.english: What kind of bag is it? What color?
lines.speaker: OFFICER

lines.english: It's a black bag. It's small.
lines.speaker: TOURIST

lines.english: What's inside it?
lines.speaker: OFFICER

lines.english: A passport, money, and a phone.
lines.speaker: TOURIST

lines.amharic: የፖሊስ ሪፖርት እንሞላለን። ኤምባሲዎንም ማነጋገር አለብዎት።
lines.english: We'll fill out a police report. You should also contact your embassy.
lines.speaker: OFFICER
lines.transliteration: ya-polis riport inimolalan. embasiwonm managagar allabwot.

lines.amharic: ኤምባሲዬ የት ነው? ስልክ መደወል እችላለሁ?
lines.english: Where is my embassy? Can I make a phone call?
lines.speaker: TOURIST
lines.transliteration: embasiye yat naw? silik madawal ichilalahu?

lines.amharic: አዎ፣ እዚህ ስልክ አለ። ደረሰኝ እሰጥዎታለሁ። ተስፋ አታቋርጡ።
lines.english: Yes, there's a phone here. I'll give you a receipt. Don't lose hope.
lines.speaker: OFFICER
lines.transliteration: awo, izzih silik alla. darasany isatiwotalahu. tasfa atakwarit'u.
